resources.name: Texas Adult Protective Services – Austin
resources.description: Get fast help if someone is hurting, neglecting, or taking money from an older person. This state group checks reports of harm to people age 65 or older and adults with disabilities. They can visit the home, talk with you, and help you make a safety plan. They may work with police or lawyers if a crime happened. You can call for yourself or for someone you worry about. You can ask to stay private when you call.
resources.availability_status: 24/7 hotline for reports of harm to older adults

resources.name: AGE of Central Texas – Caregiver and Senior Support
resources.description: Get help for older adults who live alone, like classes, support, and day programs. Staff can explain choices after money harm, and help you find legal and safety help. They offer memory care day programs, help with rides, and support groups for family. They also share trusted places for money and power of attorney questions. Some help is free or low cost. Call to ask what fits your situation.
resources.availability_status: Call for current program openings and waitlists

resources.name: Texas Legal Services Center – Elder Financial Safety
resources.description: Get free or low-cost legal help for older adults with money harm or family money fights. Lawyers can help with stolen money, scams, power of attorney abuse, and safety plans. They may help with protective orders, simple wills, and stopping someone from using your money. Help is for people with low income or other special needs. Call to see if you can get help and how to start.
resources.address: 1920 East Riverside Drive, Suite A-120, Austin, TX 78741
resources.availability_status: Call for screening; some programs may have waitlists

resources.name: Texas RioGrande Legal Aid – Austin
resources.description: Get free legal help for low-income people, including older adults hurt by family money misuse. Lawyers can help with stolen funds, fraud, power of attorney abuse, and safety plans. They can also help with housing, benefits, and some crime victim rights. You must meet income and case type rules to get help. Call first to see if they can take your case.
resources.availability_status: High demand – call early in the day for best chance

resources.name: Family Eldercare – Financial and Safety Support for Seniors
resources.description: Get help if you are an older adult and feel unsafe with your money or care. This group can help manage bills, pay rent and utilities, and protect money from harm. They also offer guardianship help when a court says it is needed. Staff can visit, check on safety, and link you to other help like food or rides. Many programs are for low-income older adults in Central Texas. Call to ask which program fits you.
resources.availability_status: Some programs have waitlists – call to check

resources.name: Area Agency on Aging of the Capital Area
resources.description: Get free help for people age 60 or older, like money, safety, and benefit advice. Staff can help you understand Medicare, Medicaid, and other programs. They can connect you to meal programs, rides, and other senior help. Call and ask for help for an older person in Travis County.

resources.availability_status: Open for calls during business hours
